notes.title: "VARLET" Now Available!
notes.content:
Not someone else—this is the story of finding yourself.
"VARLET" is now available!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406620/VARLET/"][/dynamiclink]

To commemorate the release of "VARLET," we are also unveiling a special illustration by RIRI Yamashita, who created the game’s opening animation!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/addab5071b7021a00c0cd83a46d2eee153b91d38.png"]illustration by 山下RIRI（@RIRI45309899）



Furthermore, a limited-time launch sale is being held to celebrate the release of "VARLET"!
The Digital Deluxe Edition, which allows you to experience the world of "VARLET" in even greater depth, is also available at a discount alongside the main game. Don’t miss this opportunity!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/b2cadc4fb474b1645330e340da760764955d2588.png"]

\[Digital Deluxe Edition (Bundle) here]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57020/VARLET_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/"][/dynamiclink]\[Contents]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/8e5b8fe91cee2d06b1da9e3c512dfd786472273e.png"] The "VARLET" Digital Deluxe Edition is a set that includes the full game (download version) along with the following content:

■ VARLET - (Digital Version)

■ Digital Creative Artbook (80 pages)*

■ Digital Special Album (53 tracks)

■ Monark & The Caligula Effect 2 School Uniform Set DLC

Be sure to grab the Digital Deluxe Edition and enjoy the world of "VARLET" even more!

―――――――――――

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"]

Self discovery begins with you. 



 "VARLET" These students struggle to find their own answer while coping with the difficulties of growing up. As you get to know them, you'll come to know more about yourself in this school life RPG.

notes.title: "VARLET" game controls update
notes.content:
Regarding our developing project "VARLET," we have received feedback about conforming the keyboard and mouse controls. Here, we would like to officially announce that the keyboard and mouse controls will be available.

In order to enhance the gaming experience for various players, we are currently adjusting the programs before the release.

Thank you for your support of "VARLET."

＝＝＝＝

As you get to know them, you'll come to know more about yourself in this school life RPG.
